summary: High Roller Technologies filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) announcing its wholly owned subsidiary ROLR US LLC received a guaranteed introducing broker license from the National Futures Association (NFA) to enter prediction markets, with operations guaranteed by Crypto.com FCM via a guarantee agreement with OG Markets US, Inc. No deal terms, prices, or stakes are involved. The filing is a routine regulatory milestone update for a planned platform launch, not a special situation. What to watch: Monitor regulatory approvals and progress toward commercial launch of the ROLR prediction markets platform.
